              try
                set theParticipants to participants of aChat

                end if
              end try

              end try
              copy participantInfo to end of participantList
            end repeat
            set chatInfo to chatInfo & {participant:participantList}
            
            
            copy chatInfo to end of chatList
          end repeat
          return chatList
        end tell
      '
